_doc: The threat director (Risk of Rain style), agreed 16 October 2026 (doc 23). It earns credits every second and spends them in bursts on monster cards. Income = base_per_second x difficulty coefficient^income_exponent x phase multiplier x ambient share. The difficulty coefficient climbs with run minutes and never resets; it also drives the existing monster health/damage growth (encounters.json scaling). Card cost is fixed (a realm may override it); an elite costs its card x the word's cost_mult (elites.json). Champions are unnamed boss-sized monsters bought from the same budget. Named bosses, patrols, packs and ley waves are events outside the director. Numbers are first-pass; tune freely (tools/simulate_director.gd prints a run).

phases._doc: Multipliers on income. Day pressure follows the existing day phases (encounters.json day_spawn_phases); night is the teleporter event and creeps up the longer the boss lives; rest (aftermath and camp) earns nothing.

elites._doc: Chance a purchase is upgraded to an elite (one word, elites.json cost_mult) once the run is old enough and the budget allows.

champions._doc: Unnamed bosses: a big card at boss size and toughness, without the named boss bar or boss chest. Once allowed, income_share of income builds a separate fund; when it reaches cost (and the cooldown is over) a champion arrives.

grove._doc: The starting forest: no overrides. Other realms list cost_mult / weight_mult per card, banned cards and a favoured element word.

crowd._doc: Near the monster cap (the last `zone` share of it) the director buys only elites, at elite_chance; money overflowing a full bank feeds the champion fund. The cap limits bodies, not danger.
